thought.text: CMS and boards are now serving (the earlier `boards` exit was transient — it's up now). Let me confirm the app server and verify all three frontends through the proxy.

reasoning_content: Both CMS (35581) and boards (38377) are up and serving. Let me check whether the app server (34237) is also up, and then try to access the frontend via the proxy (127.0.0.1:80 using the Host header).

action.command:
sleep 60; grep -aE "Local:.*34237|➜.*34237" /tmp/just-serve2.log | tail -3; echo "=== all three through proxy ==="
for app in app cms boards; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 30 -H "Host: ${app}.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/)
  echo "${app}.workspace.localhost -> HTTP $code"
done
